style:
EDIT THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET into a clean production-oriented LOW-POLY MODELING REFERENCE in neutral A-POSE. Preserve this exact character's design, costume, color palette and relative proportions. The old acting pose and tilted head are NOT to be preserved.

Make exactly THREE views of the SAME unchanging A-posed character: LEFT true FRONT (0 degrees), CENTER true RIGHT SIDE (90 degrees, nose points to screen right), RIGHT true BACK (180 degrees). Simulate rotating ONE frozen 3D model about its vertical axis. No redrawing with different proportions. True ORTHOGRAPHIC projection, level cameras, zero perspective, zero yaw/pitch/roll errors. Front and back MUST show square level shoulders and hips, centered head/nose/chin, straight vertical spine, NO head tilt or lean, no contrapposto, no bent knee, no facial acting that changes head silhouette. Mouth closed and neutral. Same scale and precisely identical vertical placement in all three columns.

A-POSE RULES: both arms extended straight equally outward and downward at exactly 45 degrees BELOW shoulder horizontal in the front AND back, elbows straight with tiny natural softness, identical wrist height and finger arrangement. Both open relaxed hands with straight grouped fingers and thumb slightly separated; no fists, no V sign, no beckoning, no pointing, no claw, no palm-up gesture. Palms face inward toward thighs, thumb side forward. Both legs straight and vertical at hip-width, knees facing forward, both feet parallel facing straight forward, soles perfectly flat on same ground plane. No toe-out, no weight shift. A-pose occurs in the body's CORONAL plane: in the EXACT RIGHT PROFILE, the two arms project over each other at the side of the torso with hands at the SAME HEIGHT as front/back; do NOT point the arms forward or backward in the profile. Side view two legs and two shoes mostly overlap exactly; do NOT offset them into a walk or turn profile to show both.

LAYOUT: wide landscape 1536x1024. Three equal 512px-wide columns, body centers x256,768,1280. Keep all subject pixels inside their own column with at least 20px side margins. Same crown top y80 and sole bottom y944, all three views. Every corresponding landmark matches y across all three: chin, shoulder joint, armpit, sleeve hems, elbows, waist, crotch, fingertips, knee, sock stripes and sole top. Body ground scale is immutable. Do not rescale profile just to fill width. Bare white background. NO alignment lines, NO grid, NO labels, NO text, NO border, NO floor or platform, NO cast shadow, NO floating parts. Entire body and all fingers visible. Three views only, no inset expressions or extra pose.

Style stays early-2000s Japanese low-poly real-time 3D asset: genuinely volumetric low-polygon heads, thick simple hair blocks, thin narrow short torso, very long legs, oversized chunky footwear. Primitive modeling and subtle big faceted planes. Flat unlit matte vertex colors, sparse pixel-painted facial features, visible low-resolution silhouette stair steps with nearest-neighbor aesthetic. No smooth designer toy, no glossy plastic, no clay, no studio light, no ambient occlusion, no gradients, no detailed fabric, no texture noise, no shiny eyes, no cinematic effects. Geometry asymmetry only where character design explicitly requires it, NEVER pose asymmetry.

IMPORTANT: Left/right accessories follow CHARACTER anatomy consistently: in front character left appears screen right; in back character left appears screen left. The profile shows character RIGHT side. Do not mirror accessories to face camera. Keep accessories worn and out of anatomical silhouettes. NO held weapons or loose props. Neutral adolescent streetwear, nonsexual.

characters.name: Jax
characters.extra: JAX: navy pulled-down beanie and thick black-brown spikes under and behind it, both small matte grey ear hoops, one simple chunky matte grey chain. Warm-white long sleeves to BOTH wrists underneath coral short-sleeve T-shirt with BOTH outer sleeves to upper arms. Body stays narrow and short. Navy exceptionally wide STRAIGHT cargo trousers, ONE pocket on character LEFT thigh only (front screen right, back screen left, HIDDEN on right profile), hems substantially covering huge square-toe white shoes with thick FLAT navy soles and muted teal heel patches. Do not turn trouser legs into flares. Neutral closed small crooked mouth, no open grin, head perfectly upright. The cap, chain and asymmetrical pixel eyebrows retain character identity.

characters.name: Vee
characters.extra: VEE: mint thick diagonal hair and one long side-lock/outward flick, white/lavender sleeveless cropped broad-strap top with ONE lavender chest disc, grey extra wide BELL-BOTTOM trousers with no pockets covering enormous lavender continuous platform slip-ons with white toe panels. No smile. Asymmetric headphones MUST be anatomically consistent: LEFT ear WHITE disc (front SCREEN RIGHT, BACK SCREEN LEFT), RIGHT ear NAVY rectangular box (front SCREEN LEFT, BACK SCREEN RIGHT, the ONLY visible ear cup in center right profile). LEFT wrist small lavender interface (front SCREEN RIGHT, back SCREEN LEFT); RIGHT hand NAVY fingerless glove (front SCREEN LEFT, back SCREEN RIGHT AND visible center profile). Correct the mistaken mirror placement of glove and bracelet in the source; use these exact instructions. No gun.

characters.name: Skye
characters.extra: SKYE: dark chestnut thick fan-shaped short ponytail and bent cowlick. Narrow short muted teal sleeveless ultra-short street crop tank, broad normal straps, exposed natural waist, navy loose wide-opening SHORTS, simple white top motif. Neutral closed mouth, half-lidded eyes with NO eye glints. Both thigh-high navy socks each have EXACTLY THREE wide white stripes ABOVE knee at same height all views, navy below knee; bare thigh gap under shorts. Huge white upturned running shoes, coral heels, very thick navy separate heel/forefoot sole blocks, visible arch gap. Navy cross-body strap from character RIGHT shoulder to LEFT rear hip; bag small navy box with coral triangular flap and white buckle. FRONT strap runs screen-left shoulder to screen-right hip; BACK strap runs screen-right shoulder to screen-left hip. In right profile the left-rear bag is hidden behind the body, do not shift bag to the right to display it. A-pose and level pelvis are paramount. NO V fingers, NO hip tilt.

characters.name: Niko
characters.extra: NIKO: navy low rounded LAYERED MUSHROOM hair shell with three staggered thick fringe blocks, short nape layers. Make rear crown lower rounded, not pointed star or spikes. White octagonal two-window goggles at eyes with smoke grey-olive tinted lenses, flat darker upper and lighter lower plane, navy strap around rear head. Neutral small CLOSED mouth, straight upright head, no down tilt. Short narrow blue-periwinkle zip hoodie over white undershirt, hood down behind neck, both volumetric sleeves identically rolled to just BELOW elbows. Wide olive cropped trousers end mid-calf, NOT gathered, white short socks, enormous long wide white rounded deep-opening slip-ons with periwinkle wide instep panels and huge one-piece navy soles. Tiny L-shaped flip-open remote attached character LEFT waist: front screen right, back screen left, hidden on right profile. Yellow large button and two simple white small buttons. No hand gesture, no robot, no weapon.
